summary: The calls support a first-property setup centered on affordable housing compliance, controlled overrides, tax-credit program configuration, and formal waitlists. HRI repeatedly required hard stops for HOME rent and occupancy violations, with bypass authority limited to senior compliance staff. Later calls confirmed those requirements and clarified that a UVR warning must be a stop, not merely an alert. Calls c3–c16 were voicemail or prospecting attempts and added no configuration decisions.
